scope: Additive BUF-MIN final-source gate after official club surfaces reached Final. Reuses the immutable Week 9 baseline, the verified Monday kickoff closeout, both official final inactive lists and same-day roster/elevation facts. Binds Buffalo 23, Minnesota 6. At the observation cutoff the official NFL game center had reached Final but did not expose a downloadable final gamebook; complete starters, substitutes, participation/DNP, printed injury/return, specialist and official snap coverage remain explicit UNRESOLVED fields. No started-game prediction, fair, carried rating, historical receipt or market field is changed.
estimationPolicy: Factual preparation only. Missing participation, exposure, replacements and values are not zero. An official final score without the complete final gamebook does not support a paired numerical evaluation. No new numerical method is authorized.

sources.finding: Official Minnesota game center reached FINAL with Buffalo 23 and Minnesota 6; Buffalo moved to 7-1 and Minnesota to 6-2.

safeguards: Dawkins and Anderson remain one combined offensive-line exposure chain; they are not separate additive starter losses without distinct final replacements and values.
Gaines and Danna may not be double-counted through overlapping defensive-line or edge replacement duties.
Palmer reserve status and Sherfield elevation do not establish a one-for-one receiver workload.
Jackson, Thomas and Ward remain one safety allocation question until final participation is bound.
Jennings absence and Beckham activation do not establish a one-for-one receiver workload.
Claiborne reserve status does not establish a value-invariant replacement committee or zero loss.
Missing participation, replacement values and exposure are never zero.
